issues.title: Mid-transaction parent-symlink retarget can leave staging in the original target
issues.first_found: V-17 independent review R-0002; behavior present since v0.2.0
issues.notes: Repro: retarget the immediate parent symlink inside checkpoint_directory_transaction before publication; the transaction fails closed and preserves the new target, but cleanup through the retargeted path leaves .<name>.tmp-* in the original directory. Suggested fix: resolve the parent once at transaction start or retain a directory fd and clean up through that stable identity.

Suggested fix: classify that initial OSError through the same CheckpointIOError mapping used by staging creation.

issues.title: A definite placeholder-mkdir failure on the NFS-compatible path leaves staging and is reported as ambiguous
issues.first_found: S-04 independent pre-real-NFS review R-0010; introduced by the dev/0.3 S-04 candidate
issues.notes: Repro: force the NFS fallback and make os.mkdir(target) raise ENOSPC without creating the target; the candidate reports an ambiguous outcome and preserves a checkpoint-sized staging tree. After a failed claim, lstat the target: if absent, raise a definite CheckpointIOError and remove staging; retain the ambiguous path only when the target exists but cannot be claimed. Cover ENOSPC, EDQUOT, EROFS, EACCES, and EIO.

issues.title: Channel production warm-start A.p cache retains one pressure field and exceeds the frozen peak-reserved gate at R512
issues.notes: Runtime 85ba3ae includes the 2573dec production Channel warm-start A.p cache. H100 job 10911538 found channel_legacy and channel_compiled_v2 at R512 reserved 562036736 versus baseline 545259520 bytes (ratio 1.0307692307692307 > the unchanged 1.03 limit), while all timing, numerical and scientific gates passed. R-0028 CPU torch.profiler evidence refined the mechanism: at R512, candidate cache-on and the persistent-cache-off harness both peaked at 316339328 live bytes, while the true f94b9be pre-2573dec source peaked at 309785728 bytes, exactly one pressure field lower. The peak increase therefore comes from 2573dec extending the solve-local A.p tensor lifetime, not from the persistent cache fields themselves; its magnitude and attribution to 2573dec are unchanged. D-0012 requires a non-qualifying baseline/cache-on/exact-revert-proxy H100 diagnostic before choosing whether to withdraw the cache and rerun cumulative qualification or make a separate user decision; no exception is accepted yet.
